title: Python ML Pipeline with Scikit-Learn
description: Build an end-to-end machine learning pipeline using Scikit-Learn with data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Construct a production-ready ML pipeline using Scikit-Learn that handles data loading, preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and serialization. The pipeline should handle missing values, encode categorical features, and scale numerical features.

### Environment
- Python 3.12 with pip
- Pre-installed: scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, seaborn
- Dataset: customer_churn.csv (pre-provided)
- Working directory: /opt/ml-pipeline

### Tasks
1. Load the customer churn dataset and perform EDA (shape, dtypes, missing values)
2. Create a preprocessing pipeline with SimpleImputer, StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
3. Split data into train/test sets with stratification
4. Train a Random Forest classifier with hyperparameter tuning via GridSearchCV
5. Evaluate the model with accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and ROC-AUC
6. Generate a classification report and confusion matrix
7. Serialize the trained pipeline using joblib
8. Write a prediction script that loads the pipeline and predicts on new data

### Permissions & Access
- Container runs as root
- pip packages pre-installed
- Dataset at /opt/ml-pipeline/data/customer_churn.csv

title: Neural Network with PyTorch: Image Classification
description: Build and train a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) on CIFAR-10 using PyTorch with data augmentation and learning rate scheduling.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Implement a CNN from scratch using PyTorch to classify CIFAR-10 images. Apply modern deep learning techniques including data augmentation, batch normalization, learning rate scheduling, and early stopping.

### Environment
- Python 3.12 with pip
- Pre-installed: torch, torchvision, matplotlib, tqdm
- CIFAR-10 dataset auto-downloaded on first run
- Working directory: /opt/pytorch-cnn

### Tasks
1. Set up data loading with transforms (RandomHorizontalFlip, Normalize, ToTensor)
2. Define a CNN architecture: Conv→BN→ReLU→Pool → Conv→BN→ReLU→Pool → FC layers
3. Implement training loop with CrossEntropyLoss and Adam optimizer
4. Add ReduceLROnPlateau learning rate scheduler
5. Implement early stopping based on validation loss
6. Train for 10 epochs and track train/validation accuracy
7. Plot training curves (loss and accuracy vs epochs)
8. Save the best model checkpoint and generate a classification report

### Permissions & Access
- Container runs as root
- PyTorch CPU-only version installed
- Model checkpoints saved to /opt/pytorch-cnn/checkpoints/

title: LLM Prompt Engineering and RAG Pipeline
description: Build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline with vector embeddings and a local LLM for question answering.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Build a RAG pipeline that ingests documents, creates vector embeddings, performs similarity search, and uses a language model to answer questions based on retrieved context.

### Environment
- Python 3.12 with pip
- Pre-installed: langchain, chromadb, sentence-transformers, openai
- Document corpus: 50 technical PDFs pre-processed to text
- Working directory: /opt/rag-pipeline

### Tasks
1. Load and chunk the document corpus (512 tokens per chunk, 50 overlap)
2. Create embeddings using sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
3. Store embeddings in a ChromaDB vector database
4. Create a retrieval function with similarity search (top_k=5)
5. Build a RAG chain combining retrieval with LLM generation
6. Test with 10 sample questions and evaluate answer quality
7. Add metadata filtering for document source and date
8. Create an interactive CLI for querying the RAG system

### Permissions & Access
- Container runs as root
- ChromaDB data at /opt/rag-pipeline/chromadb/
- Embeddings cached to avoid recomputation

title: GAN Image Generation with PyTorch
description: Implement a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to generate handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Build and train a GAN from scratch using PyTorch. The generator learns to create realistic handwritten digits while the discriminator learns to distinguish real from fake. Monitor training stability and generate sample outputs.

### Environment
- Python 3.12 with pip
- Pre-installed: torch, torchvision, matplotlib, tqdm
- MNIST dataset auto-downloaded on first run
- Working directory: /opt/gan-digits

### Tasks
1. Define the Generator network: Linear→BN→ReLU→Linear→BN→ReLU→Linear→Tanh
2. Define the Discriminator network: Linear→LeakyReLU→Dropout→Linear→Sigmoid
3. Initialize weights using the DCGAN initialization scheme
4. Train with Binary Cross Entropy loss and Adam optimizer (lr=0.0002, beta1=0.5)
5. Train for 50 epochs, alternating generator and discriminator updates
6. Save generated sample grids every 5 epochs
7. Plot generator and discriminator loss curves
8. Save the final generator model for inference

### Permissions & Access
- Container runs as root
- PyTorch CPU-only installed
- Samples saved to /opt/gan-digits/samples/

1. Implement a custom Transformer encoder with multi-head self-attention
2. Train on AG News dataset for text classification
3. Extract attention weights from all layers
4. Create attention heatmap visualizations for sample texts
5. Implement SHAP-based feature importance for text inputs
6. Create LIME explanations for individual predictions
7. Build a comparison dashboard of attention vs SHAP vs LIME
8. Evaluate model accuracy and interpretability metrics

### Permissions & Access
- Container runs as root
- SHAP and LIME pre-installed
- Data auto-downloaded on first run
